resources.string: A small language model that reads a story\'s dialogue the way a person would: who says each line, and with what feeling. Character voices and feelings then get it right far more often. It reads a page or two ahead of you while you listen, on your phone, offline, and uses more battery while it does. For phones with 6 GB of memory or more. Downloads on Wi-Fi only. Needs %1$d MB.
Reads stories ahead of you for who speaks and how · %1$d MB
